# @ndigo/flags-openfeature

OpenFeature bridge for Ndigo flags — the FlagEvaluator over @openfeature/server-sdk (and the web SDK for the ./web entry), so vendor providers (flagd, OFREP, LaunchDarkly, …) arrive behind the existing SPI

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Subpaths

- `@ndigo/flags-openfeature/web`
